argument.script: async (intermediate) => { const query = '{{ query }}'; const max = {{ max }} || 20; const keywords = query.split(',').map(k => k.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean); const ct0 = document.cookie.split(';').map(c=>c.trim()).find(c=>c.startsWith('ct0='))?.split('=')[1]; if (!ct0) return { error: 'Not logged into x.com' }; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 3000)); const results = []; let accepted = 0; const conversations = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="conversation"]'); for (const conv of conversations) { if (accepted >= max) break; const header = conv.querySelector('[data-testid="conversation-header"]'); const preview = (conv.textContent || '').toLowerCase(); const user = header?.textContent?.trim() || 'unknown'; const matches = keywords.length === 0 || keywords.some(k => preview.includes(k)); if (!matches) { results.push({ index: accepted + 1, status: 'skipped', user, message: 'No keyword match' }); continue; } conv.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2000)); const chatText = document.querySelector('[data-testid="DmScrollerContainer"]')?.textContent || ''; const acceptBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role="button"]')).find(b => b.textContent?.trim() === 'Accept' || b.textContent?.trim() === '接受'); if (!acceptBtn) { results.push({ index: accepted + 1, status: 'skipped', user, message: 'No accept button' }); continue; } acceptBtn.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000)); const confirmDlg = document.querySelector('[role="dialog"]'); if (confirmDlg) { const confirmBtns = confirmDlg.querySelectorAll('[role="button"]'); const acceptConfirm = Array.from(confirmBtns).find(b => b.textContent?.trim() === 'Accept' || b.textContent?.trim() === '接受'); if (acceptConfirm) { acceptConfirm.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); } } accepted++; results.push({ index: accepted, status: 'accepted', user, message: chatText.slice(0, 200) }); } return { results }; }
async (intermediate) => { if (intermediate.error) return [{ index: 0, status: 'error', user: '', message: intermediate.error }]; return intermediate.results || []; }
